name: DGA Rating
description: Accessible 1-5 star rating widget with optional feedback and live statistics (DGA Design System compliant).
project_description: DGA Rating provides an accessible 1-5 star rating widget with an optional written-feedback field and live average/count statistics, implementing the Rating Section template of the Saudi Digital Government Authority (DGA) Design System. It ships as a placeable block ("DGA Rating Widget") that detects the current page/entity context, shows the current average and review count, and lets both anonymous and authenticated visitors submit a rating via AJAX without a page reload. Submissions are stored in a dedicated custom table (not entities) keyed by entity type/id and normalized URL, and are surfaced through an admin dashboard with aggregate statistics, per-URL breakdowns, filtering/sorting, edit, delete and bulk-delete. All front-end text is bilingual (English/Arabic) and editable from the admin UI rather than .po files. Requires Drupal 10 or 11 and PHP 8.1+, with no external service dependencies.
